user.title: Fire Hotspots
user.description: Satellite fire hotspots (data: NASA FIRMS). Get a free MAP_KEY at {map_key_url}.

data_description.map_key: Free NASA FIRMS key. Each update uses one transaction per satellite source.
data_description.country: Boundaries for this country are downloaded once and cached.

regions.title: Regions in {country}
regions.description: Choose what to monitor. Each choice gets its own counter and "fire" sensor.

reauth_confirm.title: Update MAP_KEY
reauth_confirm.description: NASA FIRMS rejected the MAP_KEY. Enter a valid one.

progress.download: Downloading boundaries for {country}. Large countries can take a minute.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to NASA FIRMS.
error.boundaries_unavailable: Failed to download boundaries. Try again later.
error.boundaries_not_found: No boundary data for this country.

data_description.hours: Count detections acquired within this many hours.
data_description.min_confidence: Ignore detections below this level. "Low" counts everything, like SaveEcoBot.
data_description.update_interval: How often to poll NASA FIRMS, in minutes. New data arrives a few times a day per satellite.
data_description.show_on_map: Adds a map marker per hotspot. Can be hundreds for a whole country.

abort.boundaries_unavailable: Boundaries are not available. Try again later.

rate_limit.title: NASA FIRMS rate limit reached
rate_limit.description: FIRMS temporarily rejected requests for {country} because the MAP_KEY hit its rate limit. Updates resume automatically; consider a longer update interval or fewer satellite sources if this repeats.
